details.title: Isolated DC/DC power stage
details.description: The Isolated DC/DC power stage is the main power converter stage and is required to convert the high voltage DC BUS voltage to the desired 24V output. This power stage should be capable of handling a wide input range and delivering consistently high power at high efficiency. It needs to contain protection mechanisms for over current and over temperature

details.title: PFC power stage
details.description: The power factor correction (PFC) stage is required to shape the input current of the power supply and to meet the power factor and current THD norms such as 80 Plus/IEC61000-2-3. In addition, the PFC stage enhances system performance by reducing the RMS input current, facilitating the power supply holdup and improving the efficiency of downstream converters.

details.title: Auxiliary power supply
details.description: Auxiliary power supply generally consists of a low power DC/DC converter for developing multiple isolated or non-isolated rails used to power various subsystems in end equipments such as PWM controllers, gate drivers, sense and feedback components. It can be made of multiple stages where the output from the main DC/DC converter could be fed to further low voltage DC/DC converters or LDOs. A typical aspect of the auxiliary power supply is its low standby power which is important in improving the overall system efficiency.
